changes: Added extra window when following a vehicle to show the name of the vehicle.
Hid the mouse when grabbing an object so it feels a bit nicerwhen translating/rotating.

Added a physics mode to integrate motion in the celestial-centered, celestial-fixed frame (CCF) instead of the inertial frame. This is a prelude to handling collision and resting contact with a planet surface. This currently cuts in automatically below a certain altitude threshold.
Fixed collapse sections and buttons in Flightplan not working correctly due to non-unique ImGui labels.
Fixed clicking on a porkchop only working when in orbital camera mode, now works in any camera mode.
Store vectors directly in the physics state rather than breaking them out by components. This saves on unnecessary conversions.
Removed a couple of very verbose debugging flags from the debug build. We will reintroduce these with a separate verbose configuration.
Gave UI right of way for mouse clicks so we aren't clicking through menus

Fixed the test maneuver thruster being extremely large.
Compute a body's sphere of influence from the Crenshaw equation if it is not explicitly specified in the XML.

Added mod loader manifest file, that allows reordering of mod (and core) data files, as well as enable or disabling them. A core manifest is shipped, which is then copied locally for user to make changes. Includes integration with the setting system.

Added ability for user to select font they wish to use from setting window, so long as the font has been defined within a mod somewhere as being able to be used by the user. This allows mods to supply new fonts as options for players.

Added 'fake translucent' flag for our basic mesh fragment shader.

Added third pass of procedural navball reducing antialising. Needs a lot more work, but provides an initial basis to develop data based ui widgets to be used both on screen and for MFDs and other objects for cockpit views or on external devices.
Fixed inconsistencies in static Orbit type checks.
Removed redundant line drawing code for vehicles that never executes as line drawing for vehicles occurs via the FlightPlan instance.
Fixed the tessellation edge length factor incorrectly exceeding 64 before being scaled by the tessellation factor limit setting which would cause the resulting level to exceed the setting.

Added debug option to menu bar to display visual animations on orbit lines indicating the direction the body will travel.

Added improvements to procedural navball. Now has azimth lines and better native antialising handling. Next step will be adding interaction support, so a user can click on it and rescale it and move around. Then support for different widgets placed on top, and moving some elements into XML definition.

Changed the Transfer Plan UI so that it only shows the Create and Correction buttons at the appropriate times.
Changed closest approach UI display to not show if the actual orbit display for that encounter is set to off. Also show if it's set to on. Reduces UI clutter for now.

Added additional pass on Procedural navball. Now include extra interim markers inside the grids, as the original navball does. Optimized the GLSL code heavily, precomputing many values. Next step is to integrate it properly for user repositioning and resizing, to replace the existing navball.
Refactored anti-aliasing approach for lines in procedural gauges to reduce artifacts.
Fixed extreme mid-grid ticks on the procedural navball were being drawn even when they should not be.
Added resizing ability to the Navball along with an option to lock the widget in place (under view menu).
Refactored line Anti-aliasing method for procedural navball and optimized more.
Added a small black border to the edge of the procedural navball.
Removed black cuttoff for now on procedural navball.

Added further optimizations to procedural navball bringing down cost significantly especially at higher resolutions. Hoisted a number of variables. Used rotational approximations in place of trig where precision wasn't really necessary.
Fixed description for terminal action showorbit. Removed reference of 'none' as it was not being handled and further clarified use of 'all' with a boolean.

Migrated the navball uniform data struct into the GlobalShaderBindings, as a start for adding central data for instrument fragment shaders. This additionally solved issues with the navball using the "wrong" uniform data when FPS was faster than rendering (or vice versa). This is because GlobalShaderBindings handles multibuffering itself, automatically.

Fixed a nasty buffer overflow bug with Celestial global uniform. The GPU was adding 12 bytes of padding, but because celestial was the last global buffer, when something was added on the end the data was corrupted but valid. Have padded the UboCelestialData struct and verified this working.
Moved registering mod objects from Load() to OnDataLoad() to avoid doubling of file loads.
Multithreaded transfering data to GPU during start up.
Added a mutex around staging buffer usage in SimpleVkTexture and SimpleVkMesh. Should be able to remove these when BRUTAL updates.
Added loading of Sub Part Templates from XML.
Modified loading of Assets so we can avoid branching Load() calls. The only 'Loaders' are now objects that need to load directly.

Fixed when toggling fullscreen via ALT+ENTER refresh rate from settings would be ignored, and the default refresh rate would be used. In some cases, this could be must less than the user wants. This cause caused the display to have to "pause and reset" when tabbing, but if it was still at native the change would be instant.

Added first pass of generic "gauge" system. Allows the drawing of fragment shader objects generically only defined in xml. This allows different vessel parts to draw different components, grouped together in different ways. First pass includes two "gauge components", one being the procedural navball and the other being the cross marker indicating the current point. Next step is to include positioning and anchoring data. These components are cached and draw for the vessel on a per instance basis.
Added exception propagation for loading so we can accurately get console logs of errors.

Moved all gauge data to be generated from XML definitions. Includes layout definitions allowing variations of anchoring, pivots, scales, and sizes. The UI can be "unlocked" to reposition in the game, and right click on a UI window will show information and provide editing options such as snapping, pivot based scaling, etc. For now this is stored on the main vessel part as definitions accessing standardized gauge items, but will likely be moved into command module parts soon.
Removed the old navball completely, and migrated gauges to entirely generic loading. Commented out the crosshair for the navball, as this is now drawn using a generic gauge widget.
Added first pass on rotation able to be applied to procedural gauges. This will allow procedural gauges to be rotated on screen, allowing much more flexibility than using Imgui lines.
Added a non-rotating vert shader for use with gauges. This is cheaper, so for gauge components that don't need to rotate, this is a much better use.
Minor fix, rotation matrices for non-rotating gauges were always being calculated - but these are not needed. So if the gauge is not rotating, no effort is spend calculating the matrix.

Capture attitude state at the end of the last Newtonian timestep to use as the basis for analytic attitude propgation. This prevents small numerical errors from accumulating during torque-free motion.
Save and restore body rates for vehicles.
Added several more elliptic integrals.
Replaced the Jacobi elliptic function routine with a more accurate one.
Moved large elliptic unit tests into their own files.
Added ZXZ Euler angles conversion functions.
Fixed vessel position addition into the orbit points for drawing was not always being added or being added in the wrong place for patched conic orbits.
Fixed pole lines on navball were not being antialiased.

Fixed vessel position addition into the orbit points for drawing was not always being added or being added in the wrong place for patched conic orbits. Second attempt. This time handling all conditions by making sure patches starting true anomaly is always > 0.

Decrease navball t-bar thickness to bring its fineness more in line with the rest of the instrument.
Removed unnecessary time rate from physics derivatives.
Changed maneuver gizmo rendering to render via the maneuver controller.

Animations are baked into LUTs and passed to shader so shape changes realistically travel down the plume. Multiple pulses are tracked and weighted at different points of their lifecycle.

Deleted the old RK4 physics integrator and replaced it with a modified velocity verlet integrator. This is a huge improvement in stability beause velocity verlet is a symplectic integrator (preserves orbital energy and angular momentum). The formulation here also integrates quaternions directly rather than dropping to Euler angles for attitude.
We now precompute thruster effects in the body frame prior to integration to avoid a bunch of redundant per-step calculations.
Improved thruster on time descaling with time warp. This is enabled by much more sensible handling of thrust cut-off in the physics integrator.

Fixed aliasing issues with MTSDF sampling. Now a glyph screen scale is passed in, which is used to modulate sampling when considered to the baked atlas dimensions. Below a certain point, the value becomes reduced and softens the characters reducing aliasing.

Added procedural mechanical altitude counter entirely in the fragment shader and using MTSDF font.
